values.note: Forest Service developed-dispersed camping: no reservations or fee. Monongahela rules: no more than 14 cumulative days at one site within a 28-day period, then move more than 5 road miles or wait 21 days; vehicles must stay on or adjacent to roads open to public travel.

booking.source: Monongahela NF release reprinted by Parsons Advocate 2023-04-24 (https://parsonsadvocate.com/news/pa-top-stories/headlines/monongahela-national-forest-issues-reminder-about-camping-and-food-storage-regulations/: 'developed-dispersed campsites available free of charge'; 'Dispersed camping areas on Greenbrier Ranger District (304-456-3335) in the Bartow area: ... Mower Tract (Forest Roads 227 and 235)'; 'Exceeding the 14-day maximum length of stay within a 28-day period') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/general-use-restrictions (Forest Order: 14 cumulative days within a 28-day period outside developed campgrounds), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Opens 'When Snow Free' (Forest Service 2026 opening list); no closing date published.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation ('2026 Recreation Opening Dates ... Greenbrier Ranger District in the Bartow area: ... Mower Tract Dispersed Camping — When Snow Free'), read 2026-10-22

summary: The Forest Service names 'Mower Tract (Forest Roads 227 and 235)' among the Greenbrier District's free developed-dispersed areas and lists 'Mower Tract Dispersed Camping — When Snow Free' for 2026: booking confirmed (first-come, no reservations, 14 days in 28; was reported from The Dyrt; platform none added), season recorded as opening when snow-free. The FS road layer puts the pin on FR 227C, a high-clearance road (flagged). No FS page for the camping itself; the stored website is a trail map. Hookups/facilities (reported), fees ($0) and note left.
flags: Road / criteria (human decides): Forest Service road layer (https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcx/rest/services/EDW/EDW_RoadBasic_01/MapServer/0, queried 2026-10-22): the pin (38.5705,-79.9331) sits on NFSR 227C 'REIGLE OVERLOOK', maintenance level '2 - HIGH CLEARANCE VEHICLES', symbol 'Road, Not Maintained for Passenger Car'; the main road, NFSR 227 'OLD MINE', is level '4 - MODERATE DEGREE OF USER COMFORT'. Not a 4WD statement, but the agency classes the spur as high-clearance only. AWH's note ('maintained but may be steep and rough'; 22-25 ft trailers reported) stands; the sites on FR 227/235 proper may be reachable without the spur.

Website is a trail-map PDF (https://www.fs.usda.gov/sites/nfs/files/publication/MowerBasinTrailMap_0.pdf) that shows trails only, no campsites. No Forest Service page exists for the camping; official mentions are the 2026 opening-dates list on https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation and the Forest's 2023 developed-dispersed release. Phone 304-456-3335 (Greenbrier District, Bartow) is correct.

Name: the Forest Service calls it 'Mower Tract Dispersed Camping' / 'Mower Tract (Forest Roads 227 and 235)'; the entry says 'Mower Basin dispersed camping' (Mower Basin is the FS name for the trail system).
Stored discounts are all false with no provenance (good_sam, passport_america, koa_value_kard, military, interagency_senior_access); harmless for a free site, but nothing official states them.
